fixture: dev.json (derived from m13-7-4/dev.json: identical outline, evidence, bibliography, instructions; adds argumentUnits only)
fixtureStatus: known regression sample (seen by M13.7.4); NOT held-out generalization evidence
requestUnit: assistant turns reported by PiRuntimeAdapter usage (one provider request each); tasks that spend several turns consume several requests

arms.purpose: same-day replication of the M13.7.4 baseline failure under the production ordinary-paper prompt
model-capability contrast under the identical starved input
harness hypothesis: per-section evidence partition + argumentative role + length release, delivered only through existing buildSectionPrompt parameters

arms.input: post-draft targeted collapse of detector-located restatements in glm-baseline

sharedSession: each arm shares one writer session across its five sections (contextScope writing/acceptance/<arm>/sections); arms use independent sessions

evaluation.deterministic: analyzeCrossSectionRedundancy pairs / restated sentences / limitation-sentence distribution; scanStyleSignals
evaluation.manual: per-sentence reading: harmful full re-explanation outside owner, limitation repetition outside the designated section, quote-exceeding mechanism detail, partial E9 escalation, mechanism checklist retained (LoRA freeze, rank decomposition injection, QLoRA 4-bit frozen model, gradient into adapters, small high-quality dataset result with scope, no own experiments, two abstracts only, no ranking)
evaluation.cost: usage input/output/cacheRead/estimatedCost and seconds per arm
evaluation.gate: an arm counts as improved only if harmful restatement drops AND the mechanism/limitation checklist is fully retained AND no new quote-exceeding detail appears; shorter text alone is not improvement

frozenBefore: first provider request of this round
noTuning: no prompt or fixture edits after the first glm-baseline request; unfavorable outputs retained
